title: Freddie Mac MBS Issuance Monitoring
summary: Governed local Freddie Mac MBS issuance monitoring with exact schema control, reconciled quality/provenance, aggregate-only publication, and a static analyst dashboard.
scope: Implemented: issuance measures, source-schema and period validation, documented exclusions, fail-closed quality, provenance, and aggregate publication. Planned: composition, factor/runoff/prepayment, governed analyst API, evaluated cited AI, cloud pilot, and public release.
